title: Take
description: One registered result for a work order: where it is, what made it, how it was checked and whether a person has adopted it.

version.description: Ledger record version; 2 today. Any integer from 1 parses.

profile_mismatch.description: The host reported a profile other than the one the receipt rendered for.

adoption_reasons.description: Stable reason codes for the adoption decision.

human_reviewed.description: True only when a person approved it. A rejection or a policy confirmation leaves it false.

unreviewed_references.description: Some reference was a take no person had approved when this one was registered.

reconnect_moment_ids.description: Neighbouring Moments this take should have leaned on but had no usable take for.

depends_on.description: story-core node keys (bare kind/id, e.g. character/rhea) this take leans on. Opaque to the ledger: compared as strings with changed_domains. No entry repeats.

superseded.description: A director asked for the cut to be made again. It stays as history but is no longer the Moment's current cut.
